purpose: Accumulate independent, pre-outcome production evidence for the serving VotePredict workflow without retrospective backfill or outcome leakage.

eligibility: the current legislative session is exactly 2027-2028
the bill belongs to the official Revisor universe
the bill's official status contains Engrossment
source-chamber memberships exist for the session
no official source-chamber passage outcome is present at seed time
no source-chamber passage vote event is present at seed time
no session-expiration event is present at seed time

capture.resolution: automatic only when exactly one matching official passage vote is available

scoring.primaryRevision: latest eligible serving revision strictly before the official vote date
